analysis: The question asks which NSAID is least likely to cause gastric irritation. Acetaminophen is not classified as an NSAID, and it is known to have a much lower risk of causing gastric irritation compared to traditional NSAIDs. Diclofenac, ibuprofen, and naproxen are all NSAIDs that can cause gastric irritation, with diclofenac and naproxen generally associated with higher risks. Ibuprofen has a moderate risk of gastrointestinal side effects. Therefore, the best-supported option is acetaminophen, as it is not an NSAID and is less likely to cause gastric irritation.
